title: Descent for quasi-coherent modules
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent
$\mathcal O_X$-module. Then the presheaf on the
small etale site of $X$ that
sends $u:U\to X$ to $\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$, with the pullback
restrictions, is a sheaf.
(*Classical input: Stacks Project, Descent, Section 35.8, Tag
[03DR](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03DR).*)

proof.text: Identify the underlying set presheaf of tensor-pullback sections with etaleHom(unitObj X,F). This comparison intertwines the normalized section restrictions with the canonical pullHom restrictions.

The structure sheaf is quasi-coherent, as is F by hypothesis. Apply the already proved isSheaf_etaleHom to these two modules to obtain the sheaf condition on the small étale site. The fpqc descent part of the source is thus discharged by the existing Hom-descent theorem.

Presieve.isSheaf_iso transports the type-valued sheaf condition across the comparison. Presheaf.isSheaf_of_isSheaf_comp reflects it through the forgetful functor AddCommGrpCat→Type, which reflects limits, giving the abelian-group-valued assertion. These are two direct applications of the generic categorical sheaf lemmas.
